name: x30
about: The 30 s cut of the launch trailer for X (the blueprint's x30, TRAILER_RESEARCH §6.7): ranges are LaunchFilm source frames [first, end), in playing order (30 fps, 18 frames a beat, 72 a bar). Every range starts on a bar line in the film and in the cut, so the film's clicks, cuts and lines stay on their beats and the score's own bars play under them (music.score_bars). The cut: the look; "Did it run the tests?"; the hold; the turn; the build and the dead stop; the drop at cut 12.0 s; Run the tests; the tests at 1x; the tests pass at cut 19.2 s and Verified, with Evidence before done, at cut 21.43 s; the celebration (OVERRIDES §41 moved Verified to film f1723, so the climax's range runs through bar 25, which takes the title bar's place: the end card is already whole on the final hit); the final hit at cut 24.0 s; 1.8 s of silence. The captions leave out c15 ("[The music stops]" with "AgentGuard checks the evidence", film f1453-1522): the cut joins at the release (film f1512), where the music returns, so only 11 frames of it would reach the cut. Read by tools/captions/build.mjs --cut (captions), tools/encode/encode.sh --cut (picture), tools/audio/cut_cues.py (the cut's sound effects and automation) and the score's x30 render.
